title: When the Safehouse Sings
author: Paloma Nystrom
blurb: Sebastian Brightwater, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
